name: Mokapi Local Multi-Protocol API Mocking
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local mock server for OpenAPI and AsyncAPI; supports HTTP, Kafka, MQTT, WebSocket, LDAP and SMTP, with no provider-imposed usage quota or expiration.
watch_out: Runs on your own machine or CI infrastructure; no free hosted compute or managed mock endpoints are included. External infrastructure and integrations may incur charges. Configure exposed ports and test data securely.
